grammar.numbers: one enormous number owns the stage: it assembles character by character, rising in hollow (hairline outline) and filling solid black; a stat or date in the giant size, an automatic figure at half size; a figure said while the stage is taken rides as a small chip bottom-right; never counts up
grammar.comparisons: two-column table with hairline rules: column titles, small-caps row labels, values assembling in black (tone colour only for good/bad rows), the highlighted column gets an accent underline, the question in the accent under a rule
grammar.steps: numbered typographic list: hollow numerals that fill as each point is said, items appear top-down in spoken order, hairline rules between rows
grammar.eligibility: classic verdict cue ✓/✗ (MotionTrack, mounted only while it is up)
grammar.change: the old value huge and hollow; at swapAtMs each column rolls odometer-style (staggered, in the data's direction) into the new value and lands solid, a thick arrow draws only when the data gives a direction (tone colour only when the data gives one), the old value shrinks to a small 'trước: …' caption
grammar.trend: hairline line chart that draws itself, every value printed in Vietnamese format, the last point in the accent
grammar.banks: logo on white with a hairline frame on the stage, neutral small-caps label; a chip bottom-right when the stage is taken
grammar.captionPosition: left-aligned semi-bold under the lower rule while the stage is busy, larger on the stage when it is free; keywords and numbers in the logo blue, the word being said underlined; English line in slate on SAFE.bottom

skinAxes.cover: white paper, logo tile top-left, thick rule, the title set big in black with keywords in blue, subtitle in small caps
skinAxes.captions: calm semi-bold navy on white, unsaid words in slate, keywords blue, current word underlined
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics, no footage: white Swiss grid page with a header (brand or chapter + title) and a progress rule
skinAxes.transitions: rules drawing, digits rising and rolling, a slow push-in on every held number; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: flat white paper, faint 6-column grid, a slow baseline sweep; no glow, no shake
skinAxes.sound: voice + clicks on list rows, compare columns and the value swap; ding on a stat
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
